source_snapshot.items: Upgrade / Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware by Redfish when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure: The procedure contains one copied sentence saying FPGA, then uses a generic Redfish UpdateService Immediate PATCH, binary image POST and task wait.
source_snapshot.criteria: Firmware flashes successfully after one BMC reset and FirmwareInventory reports the expected version.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; explicitly requires a HIB-CPLD image and treats the host-off Redfish workflow as HIB-CPLD.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED pending exact target, versions, secure Redfish action, reset semantics and recovery.

old_problem: Items and the exact private Script identity name HIB-CPLD, while one Procedure sentence says FPGA. The generic source POST has no visible component selector, so the previous review withheld all execution as a destructive-target conflict.
disposition_reason: For this exact row, three independent same-row facts—Items, Script identity and DeepSeek's required image/target—agree on HIB-CPLD, while only the copied Procedure noun says FPGA. The review layer can therefore retain HIB-CPLD as the row's intended component without editing the Master. The generic source URI is not approved for execution: exact image, target inventory URI, advertised push/action contract, versions, one-reset activation and recovery are parameterized Project inputs.
decision_basis: Exact Functionality row 732 and the same-row DeepSeek/GPT V2 material were reopened and matched the protected row hash.
The source Items and private Script slug independently identify HIB-CPLD; the DeepSeek package and evidence also bind a HIB-CPLD image and inventory result.
The Procedure's single FPGA noun conflicts with those HIB-CPLD-specific fields and is preserved as source history rather than executed.
ED-14 requires upgrade and downgrade to remain separate branches with independent vendor support, images, activation and recovery.
DMTF Redfish UpdateService defines service-advertised update URIs and component targets; it does not make the source's fixed `/update` path or target mapping universal.

test_case.test_name: Upgrade and downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware by Redfish with the host off
test_case.purpose: Validate two separately authorized HIB-CPLD firmware transitions—upgrade and downgrade—through the target BMC's advertised Redfish update mechanism while the host is off, with one approved BMC reset per transition, active-version verification and platform-health recovery evidence.
required_package: Exact HIB-CPLD board/FRU/device inventory identity and current/upgrade/downgrade version matrix
Signed or hash-verified HIB-CPLD images and release notes proving that each direction is supported
Target BMC's advertised UpdateService action or push URI, component target selector, payload format, task and activation semantics
Secure Redfish credentials and trusted TLS policy; stable standby power and independent OOB recovery
Approved one-BMC-reset definition, host-off state and post-reset boot/health criteria
test_case.test_command: Read-only preflight: GET the target service root, UpdateService and FirmwareInventory using protected credentials and verified TLS. State-changing phase: use only the BMC-advertised, owner-approved HIB-CPLD component target and image payload; do not execute the literal credentialed `curl -k .../UpdateService/update` example. Run upgrade and downgrade as separate approved operations, each with its own task monitoring and one approved BMC reset.
test_case.expected_result: For each independently supported direction, the advertised update task reaches its documented terminal-success state, exactly the approved HIB-CPLD inventory member changes from the recorded source version to the approved target version after one BMC reset, the host returns cleanly from the prescribed off-state workflow, and no unexpected BMC/SEL/POST/OS or HIB-CPLD health error is introduced.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when the selected direction is vendor-supported and all task, exact-component, active-version, one-reset and platform-health oracles match. FAIL on task failure, wrong or unchanged active version, wrong target, extra/unexpected reset, lost management/boot or disallowed log delta. N/A is allowed only when authoritative platform/vendor documentation proves that the specific direction is unsupported; missing images or configuration alone are not N/A.
safety_gate: Explicit approval for the exact HIB-CPLD device, image, direction and state-changing command
Prove host-off still leaves required BMC standby power and management connectivity; do not infer AC removal
Never expose the source's embedded root password or disable TLS verification in the approved execution
Maintain stable power/OOB visibility and stop on target, signature, task, health or connectivity mismatch
Do not retry, reverse direction or add resets after a failed or ambiguous flash
expected_evidence: Immutable image manifest and HIB-CPLD device/version compatibility matrix for each direction
Service-advertised UpdateService URI/action, component target selector and pre-update FirmwareInventory
Redacted request response plus complete task/job progression and timestamps
Post-reset active HIB-CPLD version tied to the same inventory member
BMC, HIB-CPLD, POST/OS and SEL/log health plus abort/recovery evidence when applicable
test_case.recovery: Preserve the first failure and task state, keep the platform in the vendor-specified safe power state, and invoke the approved HIB-CPLD recovery or alternate programming path under owner control. Do not issue a blind second flash, downgrade, reset or power cycle.

source_conflict.preserved_original_conflict: The Master Procedure still says FPGA; this re-review does not edit or erase it.
source_conflict.resolution: HIB-CPLD is selected only for this Source Key because Items, Script identity and same-row package/evidence agree on that component.

blocked.reason: Purpose and component identity are now sufficiently defined for a safe parameterized review contract; missing images, versions, OEM target URI and recovery are runtime readiness gates, not an irreducible static-review block.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact HIB-CPLD identity, images/version directions, advertised Redfish target, one-reset activation and recovery must be supplied before execution.

external_authorities.use: Update targets bind an image to identified inventory/device resources; target semantics must be discovered and cannot be guessed.
